items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Joe Zawinul in the context of Weather Report and other musicians, but the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond to these specific mentions with personal anecdotes or confirm a direct professional relationship in the provided text.

ctx.x: So I went down to the Harlem Square and hit on the man for a job. This guy was a Jew. His name was Joe--a little 'old short dude. Of course all Jews own--own the nightclubs down there. Really, actually. But his brother was the head of the liquor board, the State of Florida. So, let me make a long story short, the guy gave us--he say, well, I'll give you all a try, if you're, you know, if you're anything, you know--if you all make a, draw a crowd, make some people come in here and come in the lounge. Say, I'll…
